text: Welcome everyone, today we're talking about approval flows for agents.
When an agent calls a tool through MCP, the user should see what it wants to do.
We moved from a modal confirm dialog to an inline diff card and approvals went up.
With the 2026-06 MCP spec, tool annotations tell you if a call is read-only.
Use that to skip approval for read-only tools and batch the rest.
Here's the component architecture: a web component per tool-call state.
